estimands.population: the complete frozen 768-scenario eligible retained manifest in SHA-256 scenario order
estimands.delta: average conditional mean over that ordered manifest of BC_i minus OM_i
estimands.om: average conditional mean over that ordered manifest of OM_i
estimands.heterogeneity: conditional means may change arbitrarily by scenario and motif
estimands.cross_scenario_dependence: no independence or common-mean assumption; dependence through the past filtration is allowed while future outcomes and provider randomness are unavailable

method.name: exact-mixture empirical-Bernstein confidence sequence

source.title: Closed-form empirical Bernstein confidence sequences for scalars and matrices
source.deciding_result: Proposition 3.1 exact mixture confidence sequence for the running average of bounded, possibly time-varying conditional means

method.uniform_limit: kappa approaches infinity: prior term vanishes and kappa times the truncated-normal normalizer approaches sqrt(2/pi), so the mixture threshold is 2/alpha
method.delta_transform: Y_i=(BC_i-OM_i+1)/2 in [0,1]; map confidence limits back by 2*m-1
method.I: I(y;v)=integral from -1 to 1 of exp(y*z-v*z^2) dz
method.confidence_set: m in [0,1] such that I(sum_i X_i-t*m;U_t) < kappa*Z*sqrt(2*pi)/stream_alpha
method.primary_integral: analytic completion-of-square formula using IEEE-754 binary64 erf
method.independent_integral: composite Simpson quadrature with 16384 even subintervals
method.high_precision_witness: Python Decimal precision 60 composite Simpson quadrature with 4096 even subintervals
method.inversion: symmetric root in nonnegative y by 80-step bisection after power-of-two bracketing

progress_reporting.96: operational counts and projected cost only; no interval or scientific branch
progress_reporting.192: operational counts and projected cost only; no interval or scientific branch
progress_reporting.384: operational counts and projected cost only; no interval or scientific branch

decision.PROMOTE_TO_COORDINATION_STAGE: delta_lower > -0.10 AND om_lower >= 0.80 AND every deterministic hard gate passes
decision.MODEL_INTERFACE_FAIL: delta_upper < -0.10 AND om_lower >= 0.80 AND every deterministic hard gate passes
decision.INCONCLUSIVE_OR_UNDERFUNDED: none of the other scientific branches holds

missingness.pair_rule: any unresolved transport state in any of six calls makes the complete BC/OM scenario pair missing
missingness.joint_enumeration: Cartesian product of the four paired completions at the exact missing scenario positions
missingness.branch_invariance: report a scientific branch only if identical for every joint completion; otherwise TRANSPORT_INCONCLUSIVE

operating_characteristics.rng: SHA-256 counter stream; seed is length-framed global seed, cell_id, replicate decimal; each digest is four big-endian unsigned 64-bit uniforms divided by 2^64
operating_characteristics.categorical_sampling: inverse CDF in fixed order p00,p01,p10,p11 with half-open intervals and last-cell closure

power_targets.interpretation: clearly usable oracle and no BC loss
clearly usable low-discord oracle and no BC loss
BC is practically worse than the -0.10 margin while oracle is clearly usable
oracle is practically below the 0.80 floor

boundary_interpretation: exact threshold and near-threshold cells quantify the honest indifference region and may remain inconclusive; power is required at the separately registered practical alternatives

sample_size_selection.rule: smallest tested n expected to clear 0.90 at every practical power target with confirmatory 10000-replicate verification

cost.why_equal: only n=768 has a scientific interval, so no scientific early stop exists
cost.paid_authorization: separate owner decision after endpoint, snapshot, tokens, prices, reliability, and dollar ceiling are frozen

transport_readiness.deciding_gate: every mode-position one-sided exact Clopper-Pearson upper bound is at or below its cell failure budget
transport_readiness.simultaneous_coverage: Bonferroni allocation gives at least 95 percent familywise coverage across every frozen mode-position cell
transport_readiness.pair_bound: union bound across all mode-position cells is at most 0.02; no independence assumption
transport_readiness.clopper_pearson: invert the Binomial(n,p) CDF at observed failures using deterministic bisection

zero_failure_reference.interpretation: this buys simultaneous evidence about route reliability; it does not increase the frozen 768-pair scientific sample

transport_readiness.no_paid_claim: a route soak is no-paid only if the frozen provider route has a genuinely zero-price primitive
